documentTitle: National Curriculum of Pakistan 2022-2023 — Assessment Framework Physics Grade XI (HSSC-I)
verifiedSource: User-supplied official FBISE framework, printed framework pages 3–4, uploaded PDF pages 9–10
scope: Unit 4 (Rotational and Circular Motion), 12 summative theory SLOs
disclaimer: These are official SLO descriptions and permitted cognitive levels, not certification of question-level mappings, answers or distractors.

slos.description: Define and calculate angular displacement, angular velocity and angular acceleration, including linear-to-angular motion relations.
Use equations of angular motion to solve rotational-motion problems.
Analyze qualitatively motion in a curved path due to a perpendicular force.
Define and calculate centripetal force using F = mrω² and F = mv²/r.
Analyze circular-motion situations where tension, friction, gravity or normal force supplies centripetal force.
Explain apparent weightlessness of objects in orbiting satellites.
Describe how artificial gravity is created to counter weightlessness.
Define and calculate moment of inertia of a body and angular momentum.
Derive and apply the relation between torque, moment of inertia and angular acceleration.
State and apply conservation of angular momentum, with flywheel, gyroscope and skater examples.
Justify how a centrifuge separates materials using centripetal force.

notes: Unit 4 MCQs are currently source-matched and teacher-review-pending; most supplemental codes are assigned at topic level rather than individually mapped.
No topic-level code array or provisional cognitive label should be described as an independently verified individual-question FBISE alignment.
The original separate classroom 80-question bank has per-question SLO codes but remains teacher-prepared/provisional, not an official FBISE-certified question paper.
